SOURCE_POPULATION_SUMMARY.CURRENT_STANDARDS_AND_GUIDANCE_NOTE: The corpus includes standards/guidance current through the run date, including 2024–2026 lifecycle, model-credibility, digital-engineering and agility/planning material.
SOURCE_POPULATION_SUMMARY.LIMIT: Counts describe the evidence corpus, not votes. Standards establish accepted/current practice; historical sources establish genealogy; empirical and case evidence bear on effectiveness and failure. No source class is treated as a substitute for another.

SOURCES.exact_title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 Systems and software engineering — System life cycle processes
SOURCES.exact_section_page_table_figure_locator: Scope; Clauses 4–7 and process descriptions; official abstract
SOURCES.claim_supported: Defines a common lifecycle-process vocabulary while explicitly allowing iterative, concurrent and recursive application and prescribing no single lifecycle model, methodology, modelling approach, technique or tool.
SOURCES.relation_to_property: Lifecycle process common interface; tailoring; anti-waterfall boundary
SOURCES.contrary_evidence_if_any: A process standard is not comparative proof that every process implementation is beneficial or optimally scaled.

SOURCES.exact_title: Systems Engineering Handbook: A Guide for System Life Cycle Processes and Activities
SOURCES.exact_section_page_table_figure_locator: Whole handbook; alignment statement to ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023
SOURCES.claim_supported: Current INCOSE synthesis of lifecycle SE practices aligned with the 2023 process standard.
SOURCES.relation_to_property: Present-practice baseline across intent, requirements, architecture, integration, V&V and technical management
SOURCES.contrary_evidence_if_any: Consensus handbook status does not establish universal return on investment.
SOURCES.open_access_status: publisher page open; handbook generally paywalled

SOURCES.exact_title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook

SOURCES.claim_supported: NASA's recursive and iterative SE engine links stakeholder expectations, requirements, design, realization, integration, V&V and cross-cutting management; provides precise distinctions and process inputs/outputs.
SOURCES.relation_to_property: Core property genealogy and operational definitions
SOURCES.contrary_evidence_if_any: NASA-specific guidance; it expressly presents alternatives rather than a single compulsory method and is not an effectiveness trial.
